summary: The lava-rescue prayer branch omits the source landing message after teleporting or releasing the hero from the lava trap. pray.c:fix_worst_trouble() calls trap.c:rescued_from_terrain(DISSOLVED); js/pray.js instead records a stale hack.c gap, although js/trap.js already ports the callee.

source.branch: fix_worst_trouble() handles TROUBLE_LAVA after prayer; it calls safe_teleds(TELEDS_NO_FLAGS), calls reset_utrap(TRUE) only if teleporting fails, then always reports the rescue with rescued_from_terrain(DISSOLVED).
callers: pray.c:pleased() calls fix_worst_trouble(trouble) after finding TROUBLE_LAVA.
dependencies: trap.c:rescued_from_terrain() is already implemented in js/trap.js and can be called directly.

evidence: The saved admitted evaluation has 259/260 screens matched, 4244/4244 RNG calls matched, and 260/260 cursors matched; its first screen mismatch is segment 0 step 240, row 0 column 32.
The bounded scan at commit 7209f79f8a461df73f4beaf5c591a67678462c64 reproduced that mismatch and reported hack.c rescued_from_terrain as unported.
nethack-c/upstream/src/pray.c:373-600 shows fix_worst_trouble(); lines 397-402 call rescued_from_terrain(DISSOLVED) after the teleport/reset logic.
js/pray.js:1443-1475 mirrors the switch but uses note_unported('hack.c rescued_from_terrain'); js/trap.js:1293 exports the existing trap.c rescued_from_terrain() port.
